# Frontend exploration summary — Le Temps d'un Délice

The frontend lives under `C:\Users\duche\Projects\le-temps-d-un-delice\frontend\`. It is a Vite + React + React Router app with role-based navigation, no CSS framework (plain CSS in `index.css`), and a thin API layer in `lib/api.ts`.

---

## 1. Routes & navigation

### Route map (`App.tsx` + `Layout.tsx`)

| Page | Route | Route guard | Sidebar label(s) by role |
|------|-------|-------------|----------------------------|
| **Login** | `/login` | Public | *(none — outside Layout)* |
| **Dashboard / Accueil** | `/` | Any authenticated user | ADMIN: "Tableau de bord"; MAGASIN: "Accueil"; PRODUCTION: "Tableau de bord" |
| **Commandes** | `/commandes` | Any authenticated user | ADMIN: "Commandes"; MAGASIN: "Mes commandes"; PRODUCTION: "Commandes reçues" |
| **Inventaire** | `/inventaire` | `MAGASIN` only | MAGASIN: "Inventaire" |
| **Nouvelle commande** | `/nouvelle-commande` | `MAGASIN` only | MAGASIN: "Nouvelle commande" |
| **Magasins** | `/magasins` | `ADMIN` only | ADMIN: "Magasins" |
| **Stock production** | `/production/stock` | `ADMIN`, `PRODUCTION` | ADMIN: "Stock production"; PRODUCTION: "Stock produits" |
| **Marchandises** | `/production/marchandises` | `ADMIN`, `PRODUCTION` | Both: "Marchandises" |

- Unknown routes redirect to `/`.
- `ProtectedRoute` redirects unauthenticated users to `/login`; wrong role redirects to `/`.
- Navigation is defined in `navByRole` in `Layout.tsx` — each role sees a different sidebar set.

**Key files:**  
`C:\Users\duche\Projects\le-temps-d-un-delice\frontend\src\App.tsx`  
`C:\Users\duche\Projects\le-temps-d-un-delice\frontend\src\components\Layout.tsx`  
`C:\Users\duche\Projects\le-temps-d-un-delice\frontend\src\components\ProtectedRoute.tsx`

---

## 2. Page-by-page: content, features, “add” capability

### Login (`/login`)
- **Shows:** Email/password form, demo account list.
- **Add functionality:** None.
- **File:** `frontend\src\pages\LoginPage.tsx`

### Dashboard / Accueil (`/`)
- **ADMIN / PRODUCTION:** Global stats (active stores, pending orders, production + store inventory alerts), recent orders table, alerts panel (low store inventory, low production stock, low raw materials).
- **MAGASIN:** Greeting, store name, last 5 orders, CTA button → “Nouvelle commande”.
- **Add functionality:** None (read-only overview).
- **File:** `frontend\src\pages\DashboardPage.tsx`

### Commandes (`/commandes`)
- **Shows:** All orders (filtered server-side by role). Columns: number, store (non-MAGASIN), date, product lines, status badge.
- **Actions:** ADMIN/PRODUCTION can advance status (`EN_ATTENTE` → `EN_PREPARATION` → `EXPEDIEE` → `LIVREE`). MAGASIN is view-only.
- **Add functionality:** No “create order” here — MAGASIN uses `/nouvelle-commande`.
- **File:** `frontend\src\pages\CommandesPage.tsx`

### Inventaire (`/inventaire`) — MAGASIN only
- **Shows:** Store inventory table: product name, category, editable quantity, alert threshold, low-stock indicator.
- **Add functionality:** **None.** Only inline quantity updates via `inventaireApi.update`. Rows exist only for products already in the catalog/inventory.
- **File:** `frontend\src\pages\InventairePage.tsx`

### Nouvelle commande (`/nouvelle-commande`) — MAGASIN only
- **Shows:** Grid of all active **Produit** with quantity inputs, optional notes, submit.
- **Add functionality:** Creates a **commande** (order), not a new product/article. Uses `commandesApi.create`.
- **File:** `frontend\src\pages\NouvelleCommandePage.tsx`

### Magasins (`/magasins`) — ADMIN only
- **Shows:** Store list + “Ajouter un magasin” form (nom, adresse, téléphone).
- **Add functionality:** **Yes** — `magasinsApi.create`.
- **File:** `frontend\src\pages\MagasinsPage.tsx`

### Stock production (`/production/stock`) — ADMIN, PRODUCTION
- **Shows:** Finished **Produit** stock at production center: name, category, editable quantity, alert threshold, status.
- **Add functionality:** **None.** Only quantity updates via `stockApi.updateProduit`. No UI to create new produits.
- **File:** `frontend\src\pages\StockProductionPage.tsx`

### Marchandises (`/production/marchandises`) — ADMIN, PRODUCTION
- **Shows:** Raw-material stock table + “Créer une marchandise” form + list of active references.
- **Add functionality:** **Yes** — `marchandisesApi.create` (nom, catégorie, unité, quantité initiale). Stock quantities editable inline.
- **File:** `frontend\src\pages\MarchandisesPage.tsx`

---

## 3. What “articles” means in this codebase

**There is no `Article` type, route, or UI label anywhere** (grep across the whole repo returns zero matches).

The domain splits into two catalog entities:

| Concept | French UI term | Model | Purpose |
|---------|----------------|-------|---------|
| **Finished bakery products** | Produit | `Produit` | Sellable items (bread, pastries). Have `prix`, `categorie`, `unite`. Used in store **inventaire**, **commandes**, and **stock production**. |
| **Raw materials / supplies** | Marchandise / Matière | `Marchandise` | Ingredients at production (flour, butter, etc.). No price. Tracked in **stock marchandises** only. |
| **Store stock levels** | Inventaire | `InventaireMagasin` | Not a catalog — join of `Magasin` + `Produit` with `quantite` / `seuilAlerte`. |
| **Production finished stock** | Stock produits | `StockProductionProduit` | Per-produit quantity at production center. |
| **Production raw stock** | Stock marchandises | `StockProductionMarchandise` | Per-marchandise quantity at production center. |

**If “add articles” means adding catalog items:**
- Most likely → **Produit** (finished goods catalog) — **API exists, UI missing**.
- Alternatively → **Marchandise** — **already has add UI**.
- Unlikely → inventaire rows (those are stock records tied to existing produits, not new article definitions).

Backend note: creating a `Produit` via `POST /api/produits` also auto-creates a `StockProductionProduit` row (`backend\src\routes\produits.js`). Store inventaire rows are seeded separately and can be upserted on update — new produits may not automatically appear in every magasin’s inventaire without backend/seed logic.

---

## 4. CSS & UI components

### `index.css` (`frontend\src\index.css`)
- **Theme:** Warm bakery palette — cream background (`#f7f1e8`), dark brown sidebar (`#2c1810`), amber primary (`#b45309`).
- **Fonts:** Cormorant Garamond (headings), Source Sans 3 (body) — loaded from Google Fonts in `index.html`.
- **Layout:** CSS Grid app shell (280px sidebar + main). Responsive breakpoint at 960px stacks sidebar.
- **Components (CSS classes, not a component library):**
  - Shell: `.app-shell`, `.sidebar`, `.sidebar-nav`, `.main-content`
  - Pages: `.page-header`, `.panel`, `.stats-grid`, `.grid-2`
  - Data: `.table-wrap`, `table`, `.row-alert`
  - Forms: `label`, `input`, `textarea`, `.form-panel`, `.product-order-grid`, `.product-order-card`
  - Buttons: `.btn`, `.btn-primary`, `.btn-secondary`, `.btn-ghost`, `.btn-sm`
  - Status: `.badge`, `.badge-en_attente`, etc.
  - Auth: `.login-page`, `.login-card`
  - Misc: `.stat-card`, `.alert-list`, `.error-text`, `.muted`, `.loading-screen`

### `UI.tsx` (`frontend\src\components\UI.tsx`)
Only three shared components:
- `StatusBadge` — order status pill
- `StatCard` — dashboard metric card (optional alert styling)
- `PageHeader` — title + subtitle + optional action slot

No modal, dialog, tabs, or form library. All forms are inline in page components.

---

## 5. API functions in `lib/api.ts`

Base helper: `api<T>(path, options)` — fetch to `/api`, JSON, Bearer token from `localStorage`.

| Export | Methods | Used in UI? |
|--------|---------|-------------|
| **`authApi`** | `login`, `me` | Login, AuthContext |
| **`magasinsApi`** | `list`, `get`, `create` | MagasinsPage (`list`, `create`) |
| **`produitsApi`** | `list`, `create` | NouvelleCommandePage (`list` only); **`create` unused** |
| **`inventaireApi`** | `list(magasinId)`, `update(produitId, data)` | InventairePage |
| **`commandesApi`** | `list(params?)`, `create`, `updateStatut` | Dashboard, Commandes, NouvelleCommande |
| **`stockApi`** | `produits`, `updateProduit`, `marchandises`, `updateMarchandise` | StockProduction, Marchandises |
| **`marchandisesApi`** | `list`, `create` | MarchandisesPage |
| **`dashboardApi`** | `get` | DashboardPage (ADMIN/PRODUCTION) |
| **Labels** | `statutLabels`, `roleLabels` | UI badges, sidebar user card |

**File:** `C:\Users\duche\Projects\le-temps-d-un-delice\frontend\src\lib\api.ts`  
**Types:** `C:\Users\duche\Projects\le-temps-d-un-delice\frontend\src\types\index.ts`

---

## 6. Gap analysis for “add articles”

| Entity | Backend create API | Frontend UI | Gap |
|--------|-------------------|-------------|-----|
| **Produit** (finished goods) | `POST /produits` via `produitsApi.create` | **Missing** | Need new page or form (e.g. on Stock production or dedicated “Produits” page). Fields: nom, description, categorie, prix, unite. Auth: ADMIN/PRODUCTION. |
| **Marchandise** (raw materials) | `POST /marchandises` | **Done** on MarchandisesPage | — |
| **Magasin** | `POST /magasins` | **Done** on MagasinsPage | — |
| **Inventaire row** | Upsert via `PUT /inventaire/:produitId` | Partial (qty only) | Cannot add a product to a store’s inventory if no row exists and product isn’t listed; may need explicit “add product to inventory” or auto-provision on produit create. |
| **Commande** | `POST /commandes` | **Done** on NouvelleCommandePage | Not an “article” — it’s an order. |

---

## 7. Key files to edit (by task)

**Add produits / “articles” (finished goods):**
- New page: e.g. `frontend\src\pages\ProduitsPage.tsx` (or extend `StockProductionPage.tsx`)
- Wire route: `frontend\src\App.tsx`
- Add nav link: `frontend\src\components\Layout.tsx` (`navByRole` for ADMIN/PRODUCTION)
- API already ready: `frontend\src\lib\api.ts` → `produitsApi.create`
- Types: `frontend\src\types\index.ts` → `Produit`
- Styling: reuse `.panel`, `.form-panel`, `.grid-2` from `index.css`

**Extend marchandises add:**
- `frontend\src\pages\MarchandisesPage.tsx` (already complete)

**Store inventory “add product”:**
- `frontend\src\pages\InventairePage.tsx`
- Possibly `inventaireApi` + backend inventaire routes

**Shared UI polish:**
- `frontend\src\components\UI.tsx` (extract reusable form fields/modals if needed)
- `frontend\src\index.css`

**Routing / access:**
- `frontend\src\App.tsx`
- `frontend\src\components\ProtectedRoute.tsx`

---

## Architecture snapshot

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  subgraph catalog [Catalog entities]
    Produit[Produit - finished goods]
    Marchandise[Marchandise - raw materials]
  end
  subgraph store [Magasin flow]
    Inventaire[InventaireMagasin]
    Commande[Commande]
  end
  subgraph production [Production center]
    StockP[StockProductionProduit]
    StockM[StockProductionMarchandise]
  end
  Produit --> Inventaire
  Produit --> Commande
  Produit --> StockP
  Marchandise --> StockM
```

**Bottom line:** The app has 8 authenticated pages (+ login) across 3 roles. “Articles” is not a code term; it almost certainly maps to **Produit** (finished products). That is the main missing “add” feature: `produitsApi.create` exists but no page calls it. **Marchandise** and **Magasin** already support creation in the UI.
